options.name: active_interface
options.description: The interface on which the DNS Resolver service listens for DNS queries. Set empty value ". "to listen on all interfaces.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: custom_options
options.description: Custom options to add to the DNS Resolver configuration.

options.name: dnssec
options.description: Enables or disables DNSSEC validation.

options.name: enable
options.description: Enables or disables the DNS Resolver service.

options.name: enablessl
options.description: Enables or disables SSL/TLS for the DNS Resolver service.

options.name: forwarding
options.description: Enables or disables DNS Resolver forwarding mode.

options.name: outgoing_interface
options.description: The interface on which the DNS Resolver service sends outgoing DNS queries. Set empty value ". "to use any interface.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the DNS Resolver service listens. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: python
options.description: Enables or disables the Python module.

options.name: python_order
options.description: The order in which the Python module is loaded.

options.name: python_script
options.description: The Python module to utilize.

options.name: regdhcp
options.description: Enables or disables registering DHCP leases in the DNS Resolver service.

options.name: regdhcpstatic
options.description: Enables or disables registering static DHCP mappings in the DNS Resolver service.

options.name: regovpnclients
options.description: Enables or disables registering OpenVPN clients in the DNS Resolver service.

options.name: sslcertref
options.description: The SSL/TLS certificate to use for the DNS Resolver service.

options.name: strictout
options.description: Enables or disables sending recursive queries if none of the selected Outgoing Network ". "Interfaces are available.

options.name: system_domain_local_zone_type
options.description: The type of local zone used for the system domain.

options.name: tlsport
options.description: The port on which the DNS Resolver service listens for SSL/TLS connections. Valid options are: a TCP/UDP port number

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
